description: Diversifying across four documented style premia gives a steadier return than any one: earnings yield, ROE, 12-1 momentum and low 1-year volatility, equally ranked. Fundamentals are point-in-time: only figures filed on or before each rebalance are used. Falsified if it does not beat the equal-weight benchmark after 10 bps costs.
title: Multi-factor defensive · value, quality, momentum, low volatility · top 50 of the Top 500 (after Man Group and AQR style premia) · long/short
